name: keep-going
description: Keeps unattended sessions going: continues after usage limits reset, retries API overload with backoff, resumes cut-off responses, and compacts idle sessions before the prompt cache expires.

compact.title: Idle compaction
compact.description: "config" (default): what the config file says. "off": never. "request": when Claude or /keep-going compact asks. "policy": when the context is big. "both": either.

modelFallback.title: Model fallback
modelFallback.description: On a limit scoped to one model ("You've hit your Opus limit"), switch to the model the config maps it to and back after the reset. "config" (default) follows the config file.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show what is pending above the prompt, with buttons to continue now or cancel. "config" (default) follows the config file, which has it on.
